verdict.rationale: Svelte's own docs mention a first-party command-line checker (`npx sv check`) that checks component code, and its docs reference .svelte.ts files, which implies TypeScript support. The evidence never says that this checking covers types inside templates (markup expressions, props, events), so support for the story rests on one thin, generic mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template-level type checking, editor/language-server type feedback in markup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that template expressions are type-checked at compile time.
